objections.claim: The workflow_dispatch mechanism does not platform-select release.yml from protected main: the candidate acknowledges that GitHub executes the definition from the dispatch ref, so an off-main definition can remove the github.ref check and every needs: gate edge, then request GITHUB_TOKEN write or id-token permissions without targeting the telos-authority environment. The proposed off-main regression exercises the trusted workflow and therefore would not discriminate against this substituted-definition attack; release mutation remains possible before any trusted gate runs.

TRUSTED_WORKFLOW_DIGEST is defined over selected verifier-invoking workflow files rather than a closed, recomputed manifest of every workflow/action execution surface. A PR can add a new .github/workflows file or composite action without changing any covered file, leaving the digest equal and avoiding workflow-modified/transition-payload-mismatch. The branch publisher's .github rejection only protects Hestia-produced branches; the merge controller handles all PRs and lacks the equivalent complete-set check, so newly added push-triggered privileged code can execute immediately after merge before later digest checks fail.
